name: Capry — Female
description: Small, feathered humanoids with prehensile tails. Skilled with tools. Their species is dying, so many live freely and without long-term ties.

traits.name: Liberating Fatalism
traits.description: A Capry may choose three areas of special interest (which can change over time) and gains DM+1 whenever they carry out a task that benefits from near-obsessive focus on one of those areas — whether diplomatic finesse, starship engineering, xenobiology, or any other appropriate activity at the Referee's discretion. This reflects the Capry drive to experience and excel at things that matter to them while time remains.

traits.name: Third Hand
traits.description: All Capry can use their feather-finger tail appendage for simple tasks such as eating, opening a door, or steadying a component. The tail is not strong enough to wield a weapon or bear the Capry's weight, but whenever it can assist in a task — holding something in place during a delicate repair, for example — DM+2 may be applied to the relevant check.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 2, Mongoose Publishing
